basics.name: Alexander Prytula
basics.label: Distributed Systems Engineer | Technical Lead
basics.summary: Distributed systems engineer with 8+ years building and owning backend platforms in Node.js, Python, and Go, mostly on AWS. Combines hands-on system design with direct ownership of architecture, reliability, and delivery outcomes, across B2B and B2C SaaS products. Works as closely with product, marketing, and leadership as with engineering, and it shows in how technical decisions get made. Full-stack background rounds out the toolkit, with the main focus on backend and distributed systems.
